method: Five alternating paired fresh-process samples after one warm-up pair; identical input bytes and no concurrent verification gates. implementationMeasures: The Int comparison path precedes Float-specific checks. C Float literal parsing uses the existing helper-name discovery path, avoiding a new scan for standard-library calls in all code.

initialAttempt.note: Earlier paired trial before replacing broad strtod discovery and moving Float-specific checks off the Int comparison path. Source inputs differ from the final trial; these are retained observations, not an isolated before/after proof for either implementation measure.

ts.method: Five paired fresh-process samples after one warm-up pair; alternating order; same input bytes; worker compileMs excludes module load/typecheck and includes stdin read/output assembly. Inputs are identical; self-source output can change because shadowed runtime identifiers are now hygienic. Fixed-point and execution parity are verified separately.
